title.en: cowboys host the eagles on thanksgiving afternoon.
title.de: cowboys gegen die eagles am thanksgiving-nachmittag.
title.tr: cowboys, şükran günü öğleden sonra eagles'ı ağırlıyor.

line.en: cowboys vs philadelphia eagles on fox, thursday 26 nov from 15:30. the thanksgiving game at at&t stadium, arlington; leave the city early for the drive out.
line.de: cowboys gegen die philadelphia eagles auf fox, donnerstag 26.11. ab 15:30 uhr. das thanksgiving-spiel im at&t stadium, arlington; die fahrt früh einplanen.
line.tr: cowboys – philadelphia eagles, fox'ta perşembe 26 kasım 15:30'dan itibaren. at&t stadyumu, arlington'da şükran günü maçı; yola erken çık.

sparks.why: Cowboys vs Eagles on Thanksgiving, thu 26 nov, 3:30 pm local per the Cowboys app schedule on FOX (SeatGeek Thanksgiving guide also lists the game); the team gallery shows 3:25, so check the start.
